title: Can placement of an immediate bone level tapered implant and subperiosteal xenograft help maintain bone architecture in esthetic areas?
authors: Caiazzo A, Brugnami F, Mehra P. Journal of Oral Biology and Craniofacial Research 2019; 9: 186-189.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results showed excellent stability of the buccal plate contour six months post-operative. The authors concluded that the BBP technique can be successfully used in combination with immediate implant placement” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
